title: 1994 Nellis/Tonopah range video

tellings.quote: So, this is a restricted airspace uh you know, testing range. Nellis is famous.

related.note: Same 1994 Nellis video as telling 8, but explained as balloons drifting in the wind.

plain: Michels brings up a video said to have been filmed in 1994 over the Nellis and Tonopah range in Nevada, which he describes as a restricted military testing airspace and says "Nellis is famous." He raises it himself, without naming a source, in an episode with the UFO skeptic Mick West. The point of bringing it up is that something unexplained was caught on film inside some of the most closely guarded US airspace.
